description: This file defines server-side logic for managing tags in a Django-CRM project, including loading tags and handling create, update, archive, and restore actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads tags for the admin interface, checking user permissions and fetching tags via API request.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Creates a new tag via API call, validating input.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag via API call, validating input.

methods.name: actions.archive
methods.description: Archives (deletes) a tag via API call.

methods.name: actions.restore
methods.description: Restores a previously archived tag via API call.
